verdict.rationale: Galileo documents Experiments that evaluate prompts, models, and application code against defined inputs and chosen metrics, and dataset creation and management, including through its MCP server. The only evidence that datasets can be built from live production data is a homepage marketing line, so the trace-to-dataset curation step is not shown in docs. Missing for 10: first-party docs showing how production traces are selected or exported into a dataset, evidence that experiments run against such trace-derived datasets, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can curate datasets from production traces and run offline evaluations against them

citations.quote: Build your datasets from synthetic, development, and live production data.
Experiments allow you to evaluate prompts, models, and your application code, using well-defined inputs, against metrics of your choice.
You can use a sample dataset and sample prompt to create your first experiment.
Creating and managing datasets, Running experiments
